extracted.name: The Best Homemade Honey Garlic Sauce
extracted.description: This honey sauce recipe makes the best homemade honey garlic sauce that’s great for dipping vegetables and easy to make with 5 simple ingredients.
instruction_lines: Heat oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat. Add garlic; cook and stir until lightly golden, 3 to 4 minutes.
Stir in ketchup, honey, and soy sauce and bring to a boil.
Reduce heat and simmer, stirring occasionally, until flavors combine, about 5 minutes.
